verdict.rationale: Jules is a cloud AI coding agent that clones user repositories, so a training opt-out is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting, policy, or guarantee that keeps user code or data out of model training. The beta FAQ line about learning from usage does not describe any opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
